# 00. SETUP

```{r setup}
################################################################################
# 00. SETUP
################################################################################

# Data management
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)

# Statistics
library(MASS)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

# Options
options(scipen = 999)
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 14))
set.seed(1234)

# Switch: hypothesis blocks run only when real admissions data exist
has_admissions <- file.exists("raw_admissions.csv")
print(has_admissions)

# Key dates
date_on        <- as.Date("2022-06-01")   # delisting effective 9 Jun 2022; Jun 2022 coded post
date_off       <- as.Date("2025-07-01")   # re-regulation effective 26 Jun 2025; Jul 2025 first post month
date_announce  <- as.Date("2024-05-01")   # PM announcement to relist, 8 May 2024 (anticipation check)
date_consult   <- as.Date("2025-05-01")   # DTAM public consultation on draft notice, 22 May 2025
covid_start    <- as.Date("2020-03-01")
covid_end      <- as.Date("2021-12-01")

dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# 01. DATA CLEANING

```{r cleaning}
################################################################################
# 01. DATA CLEANING
################################################################################

# Sourced first-stage values (hand-assembled from cited sources, see source_url)
raw_first_stage <- read_csv("raw_first_stage.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
print(nrow(raw_first_stage))

# Outcome code definitions
codes <- read_csv("outcome_codes.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
print(codes %>% dplyr::select(outcome_id, role, icd10_codes))

# Shop panel
shop_panel <- raw_first_stage %>%
  filter(table == "shops") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  dplyr::select(date, geography, measure, value, source_url, verification)

print(shop_panel)

# Survey prevalence
survey_prevalence <- raw_first_stage %>%
  filter(table == "survey") %>%
  dplyr::select(date, geography, measure, value, unit, source_url, verification)

print(survey_prevalence)

# Context means from HDC (advocacy letter) and Addiction 2026
hdc_context <- raw_first_stage %>%
  filter(table == "hdc_context") %>%
  dplyr::select(date, geography, measure, value, unit, source_url, source_type)

print(hdc_context)

# Admissions panel (only if obtained): month, province, age_group, outcome_id, admissions, population
if (has_admissions) {
  admissions_panel <- read_csv("raw_admissions.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      month     = as.Date(paste0(month, "-01")),
      age_group = factor(age_group, levels = c("<20", "20+"))
    ) %>%
    filter(month >= as.Date("2017-01-01"))
} else {
  admissions_panel <- tibble(
    month = as.Date(character()), province = character(), age_group = character(),
    outcome_id = character(), admissions = numeric(), population = numeric()
  )
}

print(nrow(admissions_panel))

# Write clean workbook
write_xlsx(
  list(
    admissions_panel  = admissions_panel,
    shop_panel        = shop_panel,
    survey_prevalence = survey_prevalence,
    hdc_context       = hdc_context,
    codes             = codes
  ),
  "clean_data.xlsx"
)
```

# P1. POWER: MINIMUM DETECTABLE LEVEL CHANGE AFTER JUNE 2025 (APPROXIMATE)

## P1.1 Data preparation

```{r p1-prep}
################################################################################
# P1.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

# Monthly grid Jan 2017 - Oct 2026 (16 post-reversal months); 12-month version ends Jun 2026
p1_grid <- tibble(month = seq(as.Date("2017-01-01"), as.Date("2026-10-01"), by = "month")) %>%
  mutate(
    t        = row_number(),
    cal_m    = factor(format(month, "%m")),
    covid    = as.integer(month >= covid_start & month <= covid_end),
    post22   = as.integer(month >= date_on),
    t22      = pmax(0, t - t[month == date_on]),
    post25   = as.integer(month >= date_off),
    t25      = pmax(0, t - t[month == date_off])
  )

print(nrow(p1_grid))
print(sum(p1_grid$month < date_on))

# Scenario inputs (monthly national admissions; sources in clean_data.xlsx, sheet hdc_context)
p1_scenarios <- tribble(
  ~outcome,                        ~pre_mean, ~post_month1, ~post_month36,
  "F12.5 psychosis (HDC IPD)",      85,        170,          556,
  "F12.2 dependence (HDC IPD)",     130,       260,          830,
  "T40.7 poisoning (HDC IPD)",      35,        115,          60,
  "Cannabis, age 10-19 (THIP)",     27,        150,          150
)

print(p1_scenarios)
```

## P1.2 Analysis

```{r p1-analysis}
################################################################################
# P1.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Simulation: one replicate = draw a negative binomial series, fit the planned
# segmented negative binomial model (model-based SE, as in H1), test the 2025 level term.
# (Deviation from house style: a simulation needs one helper and replicate().)
p1_power_one <- function(pre_mean, m1, m36, drop, theta, end_month, nsim) {
  d <- p1_grid %>% filter(month <= end_month)
  level22 <- log(m1 / pre_mean)
  slope22 <- (log(m36) - log(m1)) / 35
  mu <- exp(
    log(pre_mean) + log(1.08) / 12 * (d$t - 65) +
      0.05 * sin(2 * pi * as.numeric(d$cal_m) / 12) +
      level22 * d$post22 + slope22 * pmin(d$t22, 36) +
      log(1 - drop) * d$post25
  )
  hits <- replicate(nsim, {
    d$y <- rnbinom(nrow(d), mu = mu, size = theta)
    m <- glm.nb(y ~ t + cal_m + covid + post22 + t22 + post25 + t25, data = d)
    ct <- coeftest(m)
    ct["post25", "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.05 & ct["post25", "Estimate"] < 0
  })
  mean(hits)
}

p1_design <- expand_grid(
  p1_scenarios,
  theta     = c(25, 100),
  end_month = as.Date(c("2026-06-01", "2026-10-01")),
  drop      = c(0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.30, 0.40)
)

set.seed(1234)
p1_power <- p1_design %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(power = p1_power_one(pre_mean, post_month1, post_month36, drop, theta, end_month, nsim = 200)) %>%
  ungroup()

print(p1_power, n = 20)

# MDE = smallest simulated drop with power >= 0.80
p1_mde <- p1_power %>%
  filter(drop > 0) %>%
  group_by(outcome, theta, end_month) %>%
  summarise(
    mde_drop_pct = ifelse(any(power >= 0.80), 100 * min(drop[power >= 0.80]), NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    p1_power %>% filter(drop == 0) %>% dplyr::select(outcome, theta, end_month, size = power),
    by = c("outcome", "theta", "end_month")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    post_months = ifelse(end_month == as.Date("2026-06-01"), 12, 16),
    label = case_when(
      !is.na(mde_drop_pct) & mde_drop_pct <= 20 ~ "powered",
      TRUE                                      ~ "underpowered"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(outcome, theta, post_months, mde_drop_pct, size, label)

print(p1_mde, n = 20)

# Figure: power curves
p1_figure_power <- ggplot(
  p1_power %>% mutate(post_months = ifelse(end_month == as.Date("2026-06-01"), "12 post months", "16 post months")),
  aes(x = 100 * drop, y = power, linetype = factor(theta))
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, colour = "grey50") +
  facet_grid(post_months ~ outcome) +
  labs(
    x = "True level drop after Jun 2025, %", y = "Power (alpha 0.05)",
    linetype = "NB theta",
    title = "Approximate power for the 2025 level change (simulated)",
    caption = "NB model-based SE, 200 simulations per point. Inputs: period means from HDC (advocacy letter) and Addiction 2026; trend, seasonality and theta assumed."
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(p1_figure_power)
ggsave("figures/power_mde.png", p1_figure_power, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 200)
```

# H1. SYMMETRY: F12 ADMISSIONS RISE AFTER 2022 AND FALL AFTER 2025

## H1.1 Data preparation

```{r h1-prep, eval = has_admissions}
################################################################################
# H1.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

h1_df <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "admissions_panel") %>%
  mutate(month = as.Date(month)) %>%
  filter(outcome_id == "f12_any") %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(admissions = sum(admissions), population = sum(population), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(month) %>%
  mutate(
    t      = row_number(),
    cal_m  = factor(format(month, "%m")),
    covid  = as.integer(month >= covid_start & month <= covid_end),
    post22 = as.integer(month >= date_on),
    t22    = pmax(0, t - t[month == date_on]),
    post25 = as.integer(month >= date_off),
    t25    = pmax(0, t - t[month == date_off])
  )

print(nrow(h1_df))
print(table(h1_df$post22, h1_df$post25))
```

## H1.2 Analysis

```{r h1-analysis, eval = has_admissions}
################################################################################
# H1.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Primary model: segmented NB, two breakpoints, seasonality, COVID
h1_model_primary <- glm.nb(
  admissions ~ t + cal_m + covid + post22 + t22 + post25 + t25 + offset(log(population)),
  data = h1_df
)

h1_vcov <- vcov(h1_model_primary)

print(summary(h1_model_primary))
print(coeftest(h1_model_primary, vcov. = h1_vcov)[c("post22", "t22", "post25", "t25"), ])
print(exp(coefci(h1_model_primary, vcov. = h1_vcov)[c("post22", "post25"), ]))

# Symmetry ratio: 2025 level change / 2022 level change (log scale), parametric bootstrap
set.seed(1234)
h1_draws <- mvrnorm(2000, mu = coef(h1_model_primary), Sigma = h1_vcov)
h1_ratio_level <- h1_draws[, "post25"] / h1_draws[, "post22"]
h1_ratio_slope <- h1_draws[, "t25"] / h1_draws[, "t22"]

print(coef(h1_model_primary)["post25"] / coef(h1_model_primary)["post22"])
print(quantile(h1_ratio_level, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975)))
print(coef(h1_model_primary)["t25"] / coef(h1_model_primary)["t22"])
print(quantile(h1_ratio_slope, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975)))

# Counterfactual figure (no 2025 change)
h1_df <- h1_df %>%
  mutate(
    fitted = predict(h1_model_primary, type = "response"),
    cf_off = predict(h1_model_primary, newdata = h1_df %>% mutate(post25 = 0, t25 = 0), type = "response")
  )

h1_figure_series <- ggplot(h1_df, aes(x = month)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = admissions), size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = fitted)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = cf_off), linetype = "dashed", data = h1_df %>% filter(month >= date_off)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(date_on, date_off), colour = "grey40") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "F12 admissions per month", title = "National F12 admissions with both breakpoints")

print(h1_figure_series)
ggsave("figures/h1_f12_series.png", h1_figure_series, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 200)

# Event study: monthly bins -24..+24 around each date (reference = month -1)
h1_es <- h1_df %>%
  mutate(
    rel22 = as.integer(round(as.numeric(month - date_on) / 30.44)),
    rel25 = as.integer(round(as.numeric(month - date_off) / 30.44)),
    rel22_bin = factor(ifelse(rel22 >= -24 & rel22 <= 24 & month < date_off, rel22, -1)),
    rel25_bin = factor(ifelse(rel25 >= -24 & rel25 <= 24 & month >= date_on, rel25, -1))
  ) %>%
  mutate(rel22_bin = relevel(rel22_bin, ref = "-1"), rel25_bin = relevel(rel25_bin, ref = "-1"))

h1_model_es <- glm.nb(
  admissions ~ cal_m + covid + rel22_bin + rel25_bin + offset(log(population)),
  data = h1_es
)

print(summary(h1_model_es))
```

## H1.3 Robustness

```{r h1-robustness, eval = has_admissions}
################################################################################
# H1.3 Robustness
################################################################################

# Newey-West HAC SE (sensitivity; anti-conservative with short post periods)
print(coeftest(h1_model_primary, vcov. = NeweyWest(h1_model_primary, lag = 3, prewhite = FALSE))[c("post22", "t22", "post25", "t25"), ])

# Residual autocorrelation
print(acf(residuals(h1_model_primary, type = "pearson"), lag.max = 12, plot = FALSE))

# Difference-in-differences vs F10 and F15 (national, outcome x time)
h1_did_df <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "admissions_panel") %>%
  mutate(month = as.Date(month)) %>%
  filter(outcome_id %in% c("f12_any", "f10_any", "f15_any")) %>%
  group_by(month, outcome_id) %>%
  summarise(admissions = sum(admissions), population = sum(population), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    is_f12 = as.integer(outcome_id == "f12_any"),
    t      = as.integer(factor(month)),
    post22 = as.integer(month >= date_on),
    t22    = pmax(0, t - min(t[month == date_on])),
    post25 = as.integer(month >= date_off),
    t25    = pmax(0, t - min(t[month == date_off]))
  )

h1_model_did <- glm.nb(
  admissions ~ factor(month) + outcome_id + outcome_id:t +
    is_f12:post22 + is_f12:t22 + is_f12:post25 + is_f12:t25 + offset(log(population)),
  data = h1_did_df
)

print(coeftest(h1_model_did, vcov. = vcovCL(h1_model_did, cluster = ~month))[c("is_f12:post22", "is_f12:t22", "is_f12:post25", "is_f12:t25"), ])

# Age split: under 20 vs 20+
h1_age_df <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "admissions_panel") %>%
  mutate(month = as.Date(month)) %>%
  filter(outcome_id == "f12_any") %>%
  group_by(month, age_group) %>%
  summarise(admissions = sum(admissions), population = sum(population), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    youth  = as.integer(age_group == "<20"),
    t      = as.integer(factor(month)),
    cal_m  = factor(format(month, "%m")),
    covid  = as.integer(month >= covid_start & month <= covid_end),
    post22 = as.integer(month >= date_on),
    t22    = pmax(0, t - min(t[month == date_on])),
    post25 = as.integer(month >= date_off),
    t25    = pmax(0, t - min(t[month == date_off]))
  )

h1_model_age <- glm.nb(
  admissions ~ youth * (t + cal_m + covid + post22 + t22 + post25 + t25) + offset(log(population)),
  data = h1_age_df
)

print(coeftest(h1_model_age, vcov. = vcovCL(h1_model_age, cluster = ~month))[c("youth:post22", "youth:post25"), ])

# Placebo breakpoints: June 2020 and June 2024
h1_placebo_df <- h1_df %>%
  mutate(
    plac20 = as.integer(month >= as.Date("2020-06-01")),
    plac24 = as.integer(month >= as.Date("2024-06-01"))
  )

h1_model_placebo <- glm.nb(
  admissions ~ t + cal_m + covid + post22 + t22 + post25 + t25 + plac20 + plac24 + offset(log(population)),
  data = h1_placebo_df
)

print(coeftest(h1_model_placebo, vcov. = vcov(h1_model_placebo))[c("plac20", "plac24"), ])

# Anticipation: breakpoints at relisting announcement (May 2024) and DTAM consultation (May 2025)
h1_antic_df <- h1_df %>%
  mutate(
    antic24 = as.integer(month >= date_announce),
    antic25 = as.integer(month >= date_consult)
  )

h1_model_antic <- glm.nb(
  admissions ~ t + cal_m + covid + post22 + t22 + antic24 + antic25 + post25 + t25 + offset(log(population)),
  data = h1_antic_df
)

print(coeftest(h1_model_antic, vcov. = vcov(h1_model_antic))[c("antic24", "antic25", "post25"), ])

# Coding check: total admissions and F-chapter share
h1_coding_df <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "admissions_panel") %>%
  mutate(month = as.Date(month)) %>%
  filter(outcome_id %in% c("all_ip", "f_chapter")) %>%
  group_by(month, outcome_id) %>%
  summarise(admissions = sum(admissions), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = outcome_id, values_from = admissions) %>%
  mutate(
    f_share = f_chapter / all_ip,
    t       = row_number(),
    cal_m   = factor(format(month, "%m")),
    covid   = as.integer(month >= covid_start & month <= covid_end),
    post22  = as.integer(month >= date_on),
    post25  = as.integer(month >= date_off)
  )

h1_model_coding <- glm(
  cbind(f_chapter, all_ip - f_chapter) ~ t + cal_m + covid + post22 + post25,
  family = quasibinomial,
  data = h1_coding_df
)

print(summary(h1_model_coding)$coefficients[c("post22", "post25"), ])
```

# H2. DOSE: PROVINCES WITH MORE SHOPS SHOW BIGGER RISE AND FALL

## H2.1 Data preparation

```{r h2-prep, eval = has_admissions && file.exists("raw_shops_province_month.csv")}
################################################################################
# H2.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

h2_shops <- read_csv("raw_shops_province_month.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(month = as.Date(paste0(month, "-01")))

h2_df <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "admissions_panel") %>%
  mutate(month = as.Date(month)) %>%
  filter(outcome_id == "f12_any") %>%
  group_by(month, province) %>%
  summarise(admissions = sum(admissions), population = sum(population), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(h2_shops, by = c("month", "province")) %>%
  mutate(
    shops_per_100k = 1e5 * replace_na(shops, 0) / population,
    tourism        = as.integer(province %in% c("Bangkok", "Phuket", "Chon Buri", "Chiang Mai", "Surat Thani"))
  )

print(nrow(h2_df))
print(summary(h2_df$shops_per_100k))
```

## H2.2 Analysis

```{r h2-analysis, eval = has_admissions && file.exists("raw_shops_province_month.csv")}
################################################################################
# H2.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Primary dose model: province and month FE, time-varying shop density
h2_model_primary <- glm.nb(
  admissions ~ shops_per_100k + factor(province) + factor(month) + offset(log(population)),
  data = h2_df
)

print(coeftest(h2_model_primary, vcov. = vcovCL(h2_model_primary, cluster = ~province))["shops_per_100k", ])
print(exp(coefci(h2_model_primary, vcov. = vcovCL(h2_model_primary, cluster = ~province))["shops_per_100k", ]))
```

## H2.3 Robustness

```{r h2-robustness, eval = has_admissions && file.exists("raw_shops_province_month.csv")}
################################################################################
# H2.3 Robustness
################################################################################

# Tourism provinces vs others: separate post-2022 and post-2025 changes
h2_df <- h2_df %>%
  mutate(post22 = as.integer(month >= date_on), post25 = as.integer(month >= date_off))

h2_model_tourism <- glm.nb(
  admissions ~ tourism:post22 + tourism:post25 + factor(province) + factor(month) + offset(log(population)),
  data = h2_df
)

print(coeftest(h2_model_tourism, vcov. = vcovCL(h2_model_tourism, cluster = ~province))[c("tourism:post22", "tourism:post25"), ])

# Leave-one-province-out (77 refits; loop is unavoidable here)
h2_loo <- tibble(province = unique(h2_df$province)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(beta = coef(glm.nb(
    admissions ~ shops_per_100k + factor(province) + factor(month) + offset(log(population)),
    data = h2_df[h2_df$province != province, ]
  ))["shops_per_100k"]) %>%
  ungroup()

print(summary(h2_loo$beta))
```

# H3. PSYCHOSIS: F12.5 AND F20-F29

## H3.1 Data preparation

```{r h3-prep, eval = has_admissions}
################################################################################
# H3.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

h3_df <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "admissions_panel") %>%
  mutate(month = as.Date(month)) %>%
  filter(outcome_id %in% c("f12_5", "f20_f29", "t40_7")) %>%
  group_by(month, outcome_id) %>%
  summarise(admissions = sum(admissions), population = sum(population), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(outcome_id, month) %>%
  group_by(outcome_id) %>%
  mutate(
    t      = row_number(),
    cal_m  = factor(format(month, "%m")),
    covid  = as.integer(month >= covid_start & month <= covid_end),
    post22 = as.integer(month >= date_on),
    t22    = pmax(0, t - t[month == date_on]),
    post25 = as.integer(month >= date_off),
    t25    = pmax(0, t - t[month == date_off])
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

print(table(h3_df$outcome_id))
```

## H3.2 Analysis

```{r h3-analysis, eval = has_admissions}
################################################################################
# H3.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# F12.5 cannabis-induced psychosis
h3_model_f125 <- glm.nb(
  admissions ~ t + cal_m + covid + post22 + t22 + post25 + t25 + offset(log(population)),
  data = h3_df %>% filter(outcome_id == "f12_5")
)

print(summary(h3_model_f125))
print(coeftest(h3_model_f125, vcov. = vcov(h3_model_f125))[c("post22", "post25"), ])
print(exp(coefci(h3_model_f125, vcov. = vcov(h3_model_f125))[c("post22", "post25"), ]))

# F20-F29 psychosis overall
h3_model_f2029 <- glm.nb(
  admissions ~ t + cal_m + covid + post22 + t22 + post25 + t25 + offset(log(population)),
  data = h3_df %>% filter(outcome_id == "f20_f29")
)

print(summary(h3_model_f2029))
print(coeftest(h3_model_f2029, vcov. = vcov(h3_model_f2029))[c("post22", "post25"), ])
print(exp(coefci(h3_model_f2029, vcov. = vcov(h3_model_f2029))[c("post22", "post25"), ]))

# T40.7 cannabis poisoning
h3_model_t407 <- glm.nb(
  admissions ~ t + cal_m + covid + post22 + t22 + post25 + t25 + offset(log(population)),
  data = h3_df %>% filter(outcome_id == "t40_7")
)

print(summary(h3_model_t407))
print(coeftest(h3_model_t407, vcov. = vcov(h3_model_t407))[c("post22", "post25"), ])
print(exp(coefci(h3_model_t407, vcov. = vcov(h3_model_t407))[c("post22", "post25"), ]))
```
